metadata.provider_frontier: Eighteen positive C-order 2D cases: sides256/1024, uint8/float32/float64, diff/blend/checkerboard with default8x8 tiles. Independent seed2026/2027 uint8 images; float normalization outside timing. Public decorator, conversion, method/tile validation, storage preparation, owned arithmetic, allocation and output destruction are timed. Untimed exact converted-input storage/words and public metadata/words precede seven paired rounds. Literal img_as_float remains an explicit conversion provider. Exceptional arithmetic and unassessed scalar promotion are outside this cohort. This first original/current comparison is not a prior-C++ gain or full supported-profile qualification.
